subject: Sequence degradation credit request + evidence package
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@orionai.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Orion AI Billing <billing@orionai.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 20:12:00 +0000
Subject: Sequence degradation observed 2026-08-10 — requesting credit eligibility and evidence pack

Hi Neha,

We saw a regression in sequence continuity on 2026-08-10 UTC between ~02:00–03:10 UTC where ~12% of model calls returned prematurely terminated sequences (truncated prior to expected EOS) for our primary inference route. This impacted our NLU pipelines and caused downstream retries and user-visible errors.

Attached: a small sample of request/response pairs and the minimal traces (we zipped them into a short package). Can you confirm whether this qualifies under Redwood's SLA for service credits and, if so, what the proposed credit calculation would be? We need an evidence bundle for our procurement team as well.

Orion details: committed monthly spend: $42,000; route: /v1/streams/orion-prod; request id window: 2026-08-10 02:00:00–03:10:00 UTC.

Thanks — we’re trying to reconcile with our ops and invoice team this week.

— Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform, Orion AI
samir@orionai.com
Attachment: orion_evidence.zip (attachment stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@orionai.com>
Cc: Orion AI Billing <billing@orionai.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 20:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Sequence degradation observed 2026-08-10 — requesting credit eligibility and evidence pack

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads-up and the sample. I’ve opened an internal investigation and collected the initial traces you sent.

Quick summary / next steps:
- I’ve created internal ticket R-2026-46291 and routed to SRE for impact confirmation.
- Can you confirm the invoice/account ID you want the credit applied against (if different from the HubSpot deal HD-78321)?
- We’ll validate the degraded-call definition against our telemetry (we use EOS/token pattern detection to identify premature terminations) and run the eligibility calc.

I’ll loop in Aditya (SRE) and Marissa (AM) for the calculation and approval path. Expect an update with the calculation and proposed remediation credit by tomorrow (UTC). Attaching the evidence pack we generated from our side once verification completes.

Apologies for the disruption — we’ll treat this as a priority.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Lead — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Attachment: (we will attach our verification artifacts: latency_traces_20260810.csv)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:06:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sequence degradation observed 2026-08-10 — please confirm eligibility + calc

Aditya / Marissa — forwarding Samir’s note and the sample he provided. Key asks: 1) confirm our telemetry count for the 02:00–03:10 UTC window, call volume and degraded-call definition, 2) recommend the credit amount and whether to issue token voucher vs invoice adjustment, 3) outline approvals needed (Finance/Legal).

Notes / constraints:
- Orion is a committed customer ($42k/mo).
- They observe ~12% of calls in that window appearing truncated (they provided sample).
- We should deliver an evidence bundle suitable for procurement (traces, summary calc, short explainer).

Proposed approach for calculation (draft):
- Determine degraded_share = degraded_calls / total_calls for the window.
- Use Redwood remediation formula: proposed_credit = monthly_commit_value * degraded_share * 0.80 (the 0.80 factor accounts for overlap with retries / contribution from client-side backoff).
- Cap: do not exceed 25% of monthly committed spend per incident without Exec sign-off.

Please confirm counts and final dollar amount. I’ll coordinate the DocuSign/credit memo once we have approval.

Thanks,
Neha

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sequence degradation observed 2026-08-10 — please confirm eligibility + calc

Neha / Marissa — ran the telemetry and validated the sample. Key numbers below and attached traces/calculation workbook.

Impact breakdown (window 2026-08-10 02:00–03:10 UTC UTC):
- total calls: 1,243,562
- degraded calls (truncated before EOS token by our detector): 152,944
- degraded_share = 152,944 / 1,243,562 = 0.12299 (~12.3%)

Validation notes: degraded calls were identified by our EOS-truncation heuristic (missing final EOS token and abrupt sequence length drop compared to route baseline). I attached latency_traces_20260810.csv with sample ids and the calc workbook (credit_calc_workbook.xlsx) that implements Neha’s draft formula.

Using Neha’s proposed formula: proposed_credit = monthly_commit_value * degraded_share * 0.80
Plugging Orion values: 42,000 * 0.12299 * 0.80 = 4,132.7 -> round to $4,133
Cap check: 4,133 < 0.25 * 42,000 (10,500) so within default cap.

Recommendation: issue $4,133 credit as an account credit (voucher) applied to next invoice. If Orion prefers a cash/invoice adjustment instead, Finance needs to sign off (Marissa — can you confirm preferred route?).

Attachments: latency_traces_20260810.csv (sample rows), credit_calc_workbook.xlsx (calculation and audit trail).

— Aditya
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Attachment stubs: latency_traces_20260810.csv, credit_calc_workbook.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@orionai.com>, Orion AI Billing <billing@orionai.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final: validated credit for 2026-08-10 sequence degradation (Orion AI)

Hi Samir — thank you for the sample and patience. We completed verification and have approved a remediation credit. Summary below and next steps.

What we validated
- Event window: 2026-08-10 02:00–03:10 UTC
- Total observations: 1,243,562 calls on route /v1/streams/orion-prod
- Degraded (prematurely truncated) calls: 152,944 (~12.3%) — validated by SRE using EOS-truncation heuristics

Credit calculation
- Formula used (internal): credit = monthly_commit * degraded_share * 0.80
- Orion monthly committed value (per account): $42,000
- degraded_share: 0.12299 -> proposed credit = $4,133 (rounded)
- This amount is below our 25% incident cap; no additional Exec approval required.

Issuance options
1) Account credit (voucher) applied to next invoice — preferred and faster. We can issue a token code and evidence bundle.
2) Invoice adjustment / credit memo — requires Finance sign-off + DocuSign.

Requested from you
- Please confirm preference (voucher vs invoice adjustment) and the account ID to apply the credit to if different from HubSpot deal HD-78321.

Next artifacts attached (for your procurement):
- orion_evidence.zip (samples you provided, redwood-verified samples)
- latency_traces_20260810.csv (SRE sample rows)
- credit_calc_workbook.xlsx (calculation + audit trail)

If you confirm voucher, we’ll generate a token and email it into your billing mailbox within 48 hours. If invoice adjustment, we’ll send a credit memo for signature (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/tx/ABC123) and route through Finance.

Again — very sorry for the outage. We’re following up on the root cause (model runtime kernel mismatch affecting EOS markers) separately and will share the postmortem when ready.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Account Lead — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Attachments: orion_evidence.zip, latency_traces_20260810.csv, credit_calc_workbook.xlsx
